mentions.description: A quick website for the author's in-development factory sim game, where visitors can sign up for a mailing list or a Discord to follow the project, with updates expected on the site in a couple of weeks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I duct-taped together a quick website[1], you can sign up for the mailing list or the discord if you're interested... Or just check up on the website in couple of weeks.

[1] https://keropunkgame.com/
